description: Poll the status of a checkout session created by create_checkout_link. Returns a coarse status (paid | open | expired | unknown) and the recommended next step, with NO buyer PII. When status is "paid", call get_purchase_access with the same session_id to obtain the download link.

checkout_session_id.description: The Stripe checkout session id (cs_...) returned by create_checkout_link.
